record_note: Written 2026-10-06, after the fact: this repo predates the record and was wired by hand from the kit (its gate is adapted rather than copied — bash, its own stages), so `revision` is not the exact copy point; it is the newest kit commit any recorded file was taken from (d888e29, the hook-tier fix). Kind is `retroactive` for that reason. It carries no `.ci.env.example` (its gate takes no .ci.env) and no gitignore-footprint probe; kit fixes it does not claim are REPORTED by the checker with the result of running the kit's probe against this gate. Rule that keeps this file true: a commit that edits a copied artifact updates its repo_sha256 in the same commit. **2026-10-06, probe re-sync:** the copy of tools/kit-probes/hook-tiers-agree.sh here was the one taken at d888e29. The probe gained two refinements while the fleet was ported -- it reads a full tier single-sourced as CI_DEFAULT_STAGES (four sibling repos spell it that way and have no list in their push hook at all), and it reads the gate's own --list before calling a stage a decoration, because JSOM's `coverage` is declared opt-in. Without them the probe reported those repos as having no tiers. The copy is the kit's current file, revision and adopted_fixes[hook-tiers-agree].from_revision both name 919006e, and every kit_sha256 is re-read at that copy point.
